title: 第7章 曹长老第8章 结丹之下第一人
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
小虎等人也跟着曹立一样站了起来：“见过三位长老。”
“嗯。”三位长老点头。
行刑司长老神秘的笑了笑：“小曹，你猜，我们三从长老会带什么消息过来？”
曹立眼咕噜一转，人要学会装糊涂：“小曹愚笨，猜不出来。”
“哈哈哈，小滑头。”审讯司长老背着的手收回前面，手里握着一束金黄色的卷轴，伸到曹立面前。“拿去看看吧。”
曹立看了看三位长老，慢慢的将卷轴接过来打开。
“这……”
旁边的小虎连忙把头凑了过来。
“曹哥……”小虎眼睛一亮。“不对，曹长老。”
其他围过来的小弟，立马一个个眼神都变成了惊喜。
而三个长老，则露出意味深长的笑容。
曹立愣神……
“三位长老放心，我小曹，以后一定刚正不阿，坚决维护我们执法堂的招牌，不辜负三位长老，堂主，副堂主，还有宗主大人的期望。”
曹立抓着卷轴的手在颤动，然后紧紧的将卷轴握在手里，假装很激动的看着三位长老说道。
三位长老点了点头。
审讯司老头子扶着曹立激动到颤抖的手臂。“小曹，我们相信你，有你在，我们执法堂，一定会走向更辉煌的明天。”
“你可要好好感谢唐长老，虽然你只有练气境，但你能成为长老，还是他在力荐的。”行刑司长老开口。
唐长老，则是审讯司长老唐金春，那个600多岁的老头。
曹立表现得更加激动了，连身子都在颤抖，而眼圈都红了。
“谢谢唐长老。”

老头子点了点头：“好好干，就是对我的报答。”
“放心吧唐长老，我一定会好好干的。”
“好了，你尽快熟悉一下长老的事务吧。”三位长老，幻想着未来的清闲时刻，心里美滋滋的。
这时候，内堂有个黑衣服的人走出来。
“曹队长，那个人不肯画押，审讯司不敢动刑。”
然后，这个小弟就看到了三位长老，连忙行礼。“见过审讯司长老，行刑司长老，护宗司长老。”
曹立转过头看着小弟：“怕什么，让审讯司的人动刑，证据确凿，我看他能嘴硬到什么时候。”
审讯司长老内心一个咯噔，怎么就要我们司动刑了？“发生什么事情了？”
那小弟连忙回答：“今天抓了一个人，当街行凶，抢夺宗门弟子灵石，还袭击执法队成员，公然拘捕，按照宗规，死罪。”
“大胆，敢袭击执法队成员，他是吃了熊心豹子胆了，你跟审讯司说，给我狠狠的打，老夫说的。”600多岁的审讯司长老，自然是得表态的。
“是！”小弟连忙退下，审讯司长老都发话了，这下审讯司敢动刑了吧。
行刑司长老调侃的问道：“宗门可是好久没人犯死罪了，这个人也太猖狂了，一连犯下三条死罪。”
护宗司老头也说道：“曹长老刚刚上任，正好需要一个人来立威。”
刚才的小弟三步并两步走：“审讯司唐长老吩咐，动刑。”
审讯司内，十几个小弟站在旁边，而杨开彬坐在椅子上，桀骜不驯。
直到小弟的声音传来。
杨开彬发现审讯司的人看自己眼神都变了。
“你们敢，我表哥可是葛颜，他的师尊可是燕子山山主，你们敢动我试试。”杨开彬大吼。
来人继续喊道：“这是唐长老的命令，各位尽管执行。”
“是”。

被这么一喊，瞬间有点犹豫的人，意志又坚定了。
“放肆！”
content_en:
Xiaohu and others also stood up like Cao Li: "I have met three elders."
"Yes." The three elders nodded.
The elder of the Execution Department smiled mysteriously: "Xiao Cao, guess what news we, the Third Clan, will bring here?"
Cao Li rolled his eyes. People must learn to pretend to be confused: "Xiao Cao is stupid and can't guess."
"Hahaha, little slippery man." The interrogation department elder put his hand behind his back back in front of him. He held a bunch of golden scrolls in his hand and stretched them out in front of Cao Li. "Take it and have a look."
Cao Li looked at the three elders and slowly took the scroll and opened it.
"This..."
The little tiger next to him quickly put his head over.
"Brother Cao..." Xiaohu's eyes lit up. "No, Elder Cao."
The other boys who came around immediately had surprise in their eyes.
The three elders showed meaningful smiles.
Cao Li was stunned...
"Don't worry, three elders. I, Xiao Cao, will be upright and upright in the future, resolutely safeguard the name of our Law Enforcement Hall, and live up to the expectations of the three elders, the Hall Master, the Deputy Hall Master, and the Sect Master."
Cao Li's hand holding the scroll was trembling, and then he held the scroll tightly in his hand, pretending to be very excited and looked at the three elders and said.
The three elders nodded.
The old man from the interrogation department held Cao Li's arm that was shaking with excitement. "Xiao Cao, we believe in you. With you here, our Law Enforcement Hall will definitely move towards a more glorious tomorrow."
"You have to thank Elder Tang. Although you are only in the Qi training realm, he strongly recommended you to become an elder." The elder of the execution department said.
Elder Tang is Tang Jinchun, the elder of the interrogation department, an old man who is over 600 years old.
Cao Li became even more excited, his body was shaking and his eyes were red.
"Thank you, Elder Tang."
The old man nodded: "Work hard and that's how you repay me."
"Don't worry, Elder Tang, I will definitely do a good job."
"Okay, you should familiarize yourself with the affairs of the elders as soon as possible." The three elders imagined the leisure time in the future, feeling happy in their hearts.
At this time, a man in black clothes came out of the inner hall.
"Captain Cao, that man refused to be detained, and the interrogation department did not dare to execute him."
Then, the young man saw the three elders and saluted quickly. "I've seen the elders of the interrogation department, the execution department, and the ancestral protection department."
Cao Li turned his head and looked at his younger brother: "What are you afraid of? Let the people from the interrogation department carry out the punishment. The evidence is conclusive. Let's see how long he can keep his words."
The elder of the interrogation department was stunned. Why should we be punished? "What happened?"
The younger brother quickly replied: "Today I arrested a person, committed a murder in the street, robbed the sect disciples' spiritual stones, and also attacked members of the law enforcement team. He was arrested openly. According to the sect's rules, he is punishable by death."
"He is bold and dares to attack members of the law enforcement team. He is too brave. Tell the interrogation department to beat him hard. I said so." The elder of the interrogation department, who is over 600 years old, naturally has to express his stance.
"Yes!" The younger brother quickly stepped back. The elders of the interrogation department also spoke. Now the interrogation department dares to use punishment.
The elder of the execution department asked jokingly: "No one in our sect has committed a capital crime for a long time. This person is too arrogant. He committed three capital crimes in a row."
The old man Hu Zongsi also said: "Elder Cao has just taken office and needs someone to establish his authority."
The younger brother just now took three steps and two steps: "Elder Tang, the interrogator, ordered that the punishment be carried out."
In the interrogation department, a dozen young men stood nearby, while Yang Kaibin sat on a chair, unruly.
Until the younger brother's voice came.
Yang Kaibin found that the people in the interrogation department looked at him differently.
"How dare you? My cousin is Ge Yan, and his master is the master of Yanzi Mountain. How dare you touch me?" Yang Kaibin yelled.
The visitor continued to shout: "This is Elder Tang's order, please follow it."
"Yes".
Being called out like this, the person who hesitated for a moment meant thatThe will is firm again.
"presumptuous!"
